# Azure Managed Grafana managed private endpoint

Creates one managed private endpoint (`Microsoft.Dashboard/grafana/managedPrivateEndpoints`) on an existing Azure Managed Grafana workspace, so Grafana can reach a data source over Private Link — for example an Azure Monitor workspace (`prometheusMetrics`) or an Azure Data Explorer cluster.

The parent module instantiates this submodule once per entry of its `managed_private_endpoints` input; it can also be used on its own with the `parent_id` of an existing workspace.

After creation the connection is `Pending` until the owner of the target resource approves it (see the `connection_status` output). Every property is create-only, so changing any of them replaces the managed private endpoint.

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_group_ids"></a> [group\_ids](#input\_group\_ids)

Description: The private link sub-resources to connect to, e.g. `["prometheusMetrics"]` for an Azure Monitor workspace.

Type: `list(string)`

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: The Azure region of the parent Grafana workspace.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: The name of the managed private endpoint.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: The fully-qualified ARM resource ID of the existing Azure Managed Grafana workspace that owns the managed private endpoint.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_private_link_resource_id"></a> [private\_link\_resource\_id](#input\_private\_link\_resource\_id)

Description: The resource ID of the target resource, e.g. an Azure Monitor workspace or an Azure Data Explorer cluster. Any Private Link-enabled resource type is accepted, so the value is not validated against a single type.

Type: `string`

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Paths in each resource's `body` whose changes the AzAPI provider ignores. Prefer Terraform's `lifecycle.ignore_changes` when the paths are static; use this variable when the paths must be derived from variables or other non-static values.

Paths use dot notation, for example `properties.requestMessage`. Individual list items cannot be targeted — ignore the whole list property instead. Configuration changes at an ignored path are **not** sent to Azure until that path is removed from the list.

Supplying a non-empty value requires Terraform 1.11 or later, because `ignore_body_changes` is a write-only argument. Changes take effect only after an apply, because the value is held in provider-private state.

- `dashboard_grafana_managed_private_endpoints` - Ignored body paths for the managed private endpoint managed by this module.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    dashboard_grafana_managed_private_endpoints = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_private_link_resource_region"></a> [private\_link\_resource\_region](#input\_private\_link\_resource\_region)

Description: (Optional) The region of the target resource.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_private_link_service_url"></a> [private\_link\_service\_url](#input\_private\_link\_service\_url)

Description: (Optional) The URL of the data store behind the Private Link service, as used in the Grafana data source, without protocol and port.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_request_message"></a> [request\_message](#input\_request\_message)

Description: (Optional) A message shown to the approver of the connection request.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: Override the AzAPI `<provider>/<resource>@<api-version>` strings used by this module. Each key defaults to a tested value; supply only the keys you want to override. Useful when targeting a sovereign cloud with older API versions, or when opting into a newer preview API.

- `dashboard_grafana_managed_private_endpoints` - The managed private endpoint managed by this module.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    dashboard_grafana_managed_private_endpoints = optional(string, "Microsoft.Dashboard/grafana/managedPrivateEndpoints@2025-08-01")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Retry configuration applied to every `azapi` resource managed by the module (root resource and all submodules). Defaults to `null` (no custom retry).

- `error_message_regex`  - (Optional) A list of regex patterns matching error messages that trigger a retry.
- `interval_seconds`     - (Optional) Initial interval between retries in seconds.
- `max_interval_seconds` - (Optional) Maximum interval between retries in seconds.

See <https://registry.terraform.io/providers/Azure/azapi/latest/docs/resources/resource#retry> for full semantics.

Type:

```hcl

    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string))
    interval_seconds     = optional(number)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number)
  })
```

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_tags"></a> [tags](#input\_tags)

Description: (Optional) Tags of the resource.

Description: Default per-operation timeouts applied to every `azapi` resource managed by the module. Defaults to `null` (provider defaults). Each value is a Go duration string (e.g. `30m`, `1h`).

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_connection_status"></a> [connection\_status](#output\_connection\_status)

Description: The status of the Private Link connection, e.g. `Pending` until the owner of the target resource approves it, then `Approved`.

### <a name="output_name"></a> [name](#output\_name)

Description: The name of the managed private endpoint.

### <a name="output_private_ip_address"></a> [private\_ip\_address](#output\_private\_ip\_address)

Description: The private IP address of the Private Link service behind the managed private endpoint.

### <a name="output_resource_id"></a> [resource\_id](#output\_resource\_id)

Description: The resource ID of the managed private endpoint.
